verdict.rationale: Solid components are plain JavaScript functions that return JSX, so markup and rendering logic live together in one component. It is built on established tools developers already know (JSX, TypeScript, Vite), and community users porting from React describe it as familiar and easy to pick up. One critic prefers Svelte's plain HTML over JSX, but that is a preference, not a contradiction. missing for 10: any evidence on co-locating styles within components, deeper first-party docs on component authoring.
